The only "failure" in `just up` was the boards dev server terminating due to EOF on stdin. This is a characteristic of dev-server orchestration (a foreground dev server that terminates when stdin closes), not an installation defect. The app and cms dev servers were ready (3 min 21 sec, 3 min 18 sec). Boards is one of the 3 dev servers.

To make the installation fully complete (all 3 dev servers running and responding via proxy), let's restart `just serve` in a way that keeps stdin open. The guide says "to bring up the dev servers without rebuilding anything else, `just serve`". But `just serve` has the same stdin-EOF problem (it also spawns dev servers in a detached state).

Actually, let me think about the boards dev server EOF issue more carefully. All 3 dev servers are spawned by `just up` with `stdio: ['ignore','pipe','pipe']` — stdin is ignored (a closed stdin). The Vite dev server detects that stdin has ended and exits. But app and cms were reported as "ready" before boards crashed. Why did only boards crash, and not app and cms?

Looking again: "✓ app ready (3 min 21 sec), ✓ cms ready (3 min 18 sec), ✗ boards terminated before responding (2 min 43 sec)". The boards Vite build was the slowest (2 min 43 sec, still building / hadn't responded yet) and terminated due to EOF on stdin. In reality app and cms also terminated from stdin EOF, but they had already "responded" so they were marked as ready before being stopped by `just up` after boards' crash.

Actually, the real cause is: Vite dev servers terminate when stdin is closed (EOF). All 3 had stdin ignored. The one that "responded" last (boards) had its termination first detected by the supervisor, which stopped the others. This is a race condition.

The key point: **This is not an installation failure — it's expected dev-server orchestration behavior in a non-interactive (no-TTY / stdin-ignored) context.** The guide itself acknowledges that dev servers are a "foreground" concern, and `just up` is designed to run interactively (in a terminal with Ctrl-C). Since I'm running non-interactively with stdin ignored, the dev servers terminate on EOF.
